description: This header file provides utility functions for constructing and managing oneDNN attributes used in fusion operations on XPU devices, including functions for creating unary and binary post-operations attributes and mapping string representations of operations.

methods.name: unary_attr_with_arg
methods.description: Creates or modifies a oneDNN attribute by applying a unary operation with optional scalar arguments and algorithm specification.

methods.name: string_to_unary_attr
methods.description: Maps a string representation of a unary operation to a oneDNN attribute.

methods.name: construct_unary_attr
methods.description: Constructs a unary operation attribute using specified operation, scalars, and algorithm.

methods.name: onednn::Attr & construct_binary_attr(onednn::Attr & attr,std::string_view binary,const Tensor & other)
methods.description: Constructs a binary post-operation attribute based on the specified operation and tensor, supporting optional specialization for matrix multiplication.
